page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead Build & Release Engineer
headline: Lead Build & Release Engineer | CI/CD & Developer Productivity
summary_html: Lead Build & Release Engineer with 10+ years of experience in software delivery, build automation, and production troubleshooting. Engineers Jenkins pipelines, Python automation, Git release workflows, and Linux build environments to improve developer productivity and release quality. Brings experience with reusable pipeline libraries, artifact repositories, Ansible configuration management, and cross-team issue resolution. Uses AI-assisted engineering with human review to support automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.

achievements.text: Standardized reusable CI/CD workflows, build-agent configuration, artifact publication, and release checks across engineering teams.
Developed Python automation and service integrations to streamline project onboarding, pipeline administration, and recurring release tasks.
Combined Git controls, versioned artifacts, code-quality checks, troubleshooting, and technical documentation to strengthen repeatable delivery.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Administered source repositories, protected branches, merge approvals, access controls, and code ownership rules to support shared development and release governance.

Designed Git branching strategies covering feature, release, hotfix, and trunk-based workflows, with protected-branch controls and merge standards aligned to release governance and audit requirements.
Architected reusable CI/CD templates with staged build execution, artifact retention, dependency caching, environment promotion, and controlled release approvals.
Operated Linux build runners with workload-specific pools, isolated execution, and cache configuration; investigated queue time, capacity, and build failures.
Integrated AI-assisted code explanation, test drafting, and documentation into engineering workflows, requiring human review and appropriate data handling.
Integrated GitLab DevSecOps controls into pipelines, including secret detection, dependency and container scanning, SAST, IaC validation, security gates, and policy-driven merge approvals.
Developed Python and Bash tools for repository bootstrap, pipeline variables, runner setup, and release validation, reducing repetitive developer support work.
Monitored runner capacity, pipeline duration, failure trends, queue time, cache efficiency, and deployment health to improve GitLab platform reliability and developer productivity.
Created GitLab platform standards, migration playbooks, runner troubleshooting guides, branching documentation, and operational runbooks for engineering and support teams.

Enforced SCM best practices and coached development teams on GitLab workflows, branch governance, and merge standards.
Troubleshot pipeline, container, and Kubernetes issues in partnership with development teams to accelerate delivery and reduce deployment failures.
